items.description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Legal Counsel Corporate & Regulatory to strengthen our expertise in corporate law and banking regulation.

Together with your team, you will advise internal stakeholders on a broad range of legal matters across Corporate Law, Corporate Governance, M&A, Corporate Financing and, prospectively, Capital Markets Law. Another key element of your role will be advising on banking regulatory matters.
